MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The reusable cable ties fit my recent Ethernet cable purchases and earlier cable organizers: they would help me keep the desk tidy while making future changes easier.",
    "The USB hub fits my interest in connecting desk peripherals, especially keyboard receivers and other low-bandwidth devices; individual switches give me a practical reason to consider it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming players and Alexa devices do not solve a need I currently have. My Raspberry Pi and HDMI purchases do not mean I am looking for more ready-made entertainment devices.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender assumes a coverage problem I have not expressed, while my recent purchases support wired connectivity. The TV mount similarly assumes a TV installation project.",
    "The earbuds connect to my older headphone purchases, but buying a headphone mount recently makes organizing my existing headphones feel more relevant than buying another pair."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in almost any household gadget, even when its purpose differs from my current desk setup work.",
    "My older entertainment-related purchases seem to carry too much weight compared with the more recent pattern of wired connections, equipment care, and organization."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, patch cables, headphone mount, and electric duster together suggest that I am improving and maintaining equipment I already use.",
    "I am more interested right now in accessories that complement my existing setup than in additional devices that need a separate reason to buy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my need for practical accessories but stretched my electronics history into unrelated entertainment and smart-home purchases."
}
